title: Tip It In
goal: A seesaw, a block to weigh one end down, and a ball that has to end up in the crate.
opening: A level seesaw tips towards whatever lands on it, which sends the ball back the way it came. Weigh the far end down first.
won: Down the seesaw and into the crate.
lost: Everything has stopped and the ball is not in the crate. The block belongs on the far arm, not under it.
